# {{Topic}}: research brief

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Status:** 🧊 Frozen point-in-time research artifact. Do not version-bump. Correct additively (§V at the foot).
**Commissioned by:** <session / issue>, feeding <decision IDs>.
**Method:** isolated research subagent (not anchored to the build conversation); N tool calls (N searches, N fetches); primary sources preferred; cross-read against prior briefs so this one carries **deltas**, not a re-tell.
**Evidence convention:** every claim carries its source and access date, graded `[fetched]` (quoted from the page body) · `[search-snippet]` (one notch weaker) · `[prior brief]` (not re-verified); for literature `[peer-reviewed]` / `[press-release]` / `[press-coverage]`. **No universal negatives:** an absence is written as "not found in the N sources checked" with the method. Vendor claims are labelled as vendor claims.
**Informs:** <decision IDs>
**Verification status:** <none yet / adversarial fact-check run YYYY-MM-DD>

> Briefs are **evidence, not decisions.** They answer "what does the evidence say?"; specs answer "what will we do?". No product recommendations here.

---

## §1 Method, and the honest failures
What was done; what could not be reached (403, JS-rendered, 404) and what was substituted; what was not checked.

## §2 Framework
Often a pattern table with a fit column for the product's key constraint (e.g. "safety fit").

## §3 Per-subject findings
Short, sourced.

## §7 Implications
Numbered, evidence-backed observations. Explicitly not decisions.

## §8 Research debt
